'''Alice''' is a female Acolyte NPC found at the [[Order of the Deep (Area)|Order of the Deep]] found with a young girl named [[Juno]] during the day.  

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Dialogue==
;(Day)
:'''Juno:''' Alice, when will [[Phoebe]] bring the Echoes back here?
:'''Juno:''' Since she and the Echoes left, even the little  sea anemones here have been looking a bit droopy.
:'''Alice:''' Phoebe?
:'''Juno:''' Yeah! Every time Phoebe comes here, she tells us new stories.
:'''Juno:''' Our elders always say the other side is dangerous, full of bad people. But the new stories Phoebe brings back are always exciting!
:'''Juno:''' Whenever she tells us a story, a bunch of Echoes would join in and perform with her, like a little play—it's incredible!
:'''Juno:''' I haven't seen her in ages... Do you know when she'll come back?
:'''Alice:''' I'll pass your message on to her. Knowing her, I'm sure she'll come as soon as she has a moment.
:'''Juno:''' Really? That's wonderful!
{{Dialogue End}}
